manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and the downward gravitational force remain active. Mass scales the force without changing the motion.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side views show a vertical toss. The left view shows the ball moving along a height ruler with velocity and acceleration vectors and readouts. The right view displays a velocity-time graph with a live marker.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
